topic: Matched minimax frontier for unrestricted optimal-policy value with a high-dimensional discrete confounder. Observe n iid draws of X in [d] and binary A,Y under consistency, conditional exchangeability, and fixed overlap eps. Target Vstar=sum_x p_x max(mu_0x,mu_1x), equivalently the degree-one homogeneous Lambda-plus-Gamma cell functional on the overlap cone. Prove for every n>=1,d>=2 that R_n,d,eps is comparable up to eps-only constants to min{1,d/[n log(ed)]}. Construct an explicit all-data estimator using a globally Lipschitz extension of the cell oracle functional, pilot-local tensor Jackson polynomials, centered factorial moments, clipping, and de-Poissonization; allow unknown unequal propensities, arbitrary cell masses, null cells, outcome-boundary means, and exact treatment-effect ties. Prove the matching all-measurable-estimator lower bound in every regime, plus uniform consistency iff d=o(n log(en)) and parametric MSE iff d=O(1). This upgrades the banked nonmatching lower-versus-d/n bracket and must independently verify the GPT-6 derivation rather than import it as theorem. Consumer: implementations of individualized optimal-treatment value estimation such as the tmle3mopttx workflow, where high-dimensional categorical adjustment and data-adaptive treatment maximization make the nonsmooth cell-value risk directly operational. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: GPT-6 derived the explicit extension g_a(u)=s(u)u_a1/max{s_a(u),eps s(u)}, agreeing with the oracle functional on the overlap cone and globally Lipschitz. A tensor Jackson convolution supplies, for the same pilot-local polynomial, vertex-adaptive pointwise error and an exponential centered-monomial coefficient envelope. Centered Poisson factorial identities, local clipping, integrated pilot tails, and Poisson coupling then give the d/[n log(ed)] upper contribution without cross-cell covariance; an exact Poisson moment-matching splice gives the matching dense converse. Null cells, overlap boundaries, unequal masses, exact ties, saturation, and superpolynomial n relative to d were stress-checked. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: No hard lemma was left open, but D0 must independently verify the combined Jackson coefficient bookkeeping, local pilot scale, clipping variance, de-Poissonization, and all-regime lower splice. EARLY KILL TEST: Verify Sections 2-6 together; stop or pivot if one Jackson polynomial cannot satisfy both displayed approximation and coefficient bounds, or if pilot failures lose their local sqrt(p_x L/m)+L/m scale. STRONGEST-FORM DRAFT (unverified, gaps listed inside): <repo-root>/internal/presolve_drafts/stat_discrete_optimal_value_minimax_gpt6.md.

open_problems.why_unsolved: The parent proves only a lower bound of order min{1,sqrt(d)/n+d/[n log(en)]} and an empirical-ratio upper bound of order min{1,d/n}. Its failed route isolates the missing certificate: one local approximation to the homogeneous ratio-absolute-contrast Gamma must deliver both vertex-adaptive error and the centered-monomial coefficient envelope needed for factorial-moment variance. The web literature supplies the separate ingredients but not their intersection: Zeng et al. analyze linear discrete-confounder causal functionals, Whitehouse et al. analyze fixed-model max-functional nonregularity, and Jiao et al. analyze L1 distance in probability-mass rather than unknown causal-ratio coordinates. The first donor-proof step that changes is therefore the polynomial extension on the four-cell overlap cone; it must remain valid at null cells, unequal propensities, boundary means, and exact ties and then survive clipping and fixed-sample transfer.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: Matching finite-sample upper and all-measurable-estimator lower MSE bounds comparable to min{1,d/[n log(ed)]}, with an explicit all-data pilot-local Jackson/factorial estimator and de-Poissonized converse for every n>=1 and d>=2.

writing_exemplar.why: It provides the closest structure-free discrete-confounder minimax setup and motivates closing an estimator-versus-information logarithmic gap.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: categorical adjustment creates unseen and low-count causal cells -> standard cellwise estimators accumulate sparse-ratio error -> minimax analysis exposes logarithmic information gains -> determine whether the nonsmooth optimal-policy value has the matched frontier

method_exemplars.technique: Use pilot localization around an equality diagonal, multivariate polynomial approximation of absolute contrast, unbiased factorial-moment lifting, clipping, and a moment-matched converse.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The difficult Gamma component is a homogeneous causal-ratio analogue of aggregate L1 distance, with the overlap cone replacing the probability simplex.

method_exemplars.technique: Split smooth and nonsmooth coordinate regimes, use unbiased polynomial estimators in rare cells, clip unstable terms, and compare Poissonized with multinomial risk.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It supplies the general additive-functional estimator architecture whose localization and variance proof must become homogeneous in unknown cell mass.

method_exemplars.technique: Pair best approximation of absolute value with moment-matched least-favorable priors and a mixture-distance bound.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It makes the same approximation error control both a nonsmooth estimator and an all-estimator lower bound, which is the required upper/lower splice.

open_problems.open_problem: Construct uniformly honest confidence intervals for the unrestricted high-dimensional discrete optimal value whose expected length tracks the sharp point-risk scale when exact ties and sparse cells are allowed.

source_refs.claim: Characterizes pathwise differentiability of optimal value and constructs online root-n inference at some exceptional laws with nonunique optimal treatments.
source_refs.author: Alexander R. Luedtke, Mark J. van der Laan

source_refs.claim: Develops softmax-smoothing confidence intervals for optimal policy value and explains why the defining maximum blocks direct standard semiparametric inference.
source_refs.author: Justin Whitehouse, Qizhao Chen, Morgane Austern, Vasilis Syrgkanis

source_refs.claim: Shows that honest confidence-interval length is governed by ordered moduli and can differ sharply from point-estimation risk.
source_refs.author: T. Tony Cai, Mark G. Low

open_problems.why_unsolved: Fixed-model optimal-value papers handle exceptional-law coverage through online one-step or softmax arguments, whereas the large-alphabet regime can have point risk much slower than 1/n and no uniform influence-function expansion. The prior discrete run explicitly excluded confidence-interval adaptation, and the prior honest-adaptation run did not connect its lower experiment to a matching interval. The first proof step that fails is uniform calibration: for a clipped, pilot-selected sum of centered factorial moments, polynomial-approximation bias can be the same order as the interval width, so a martingale or triangular-array CLT alone cannot guarantee coverage. A resolution must incorporate bias by inversion or explicit envelopes and impose coverage, rather than only MSE, in the sparse causal lower mixtures.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A finite-sample or uniform-asymptotic confidence procedure with infimum coverage at least 1-alpha over the full overlap model and worst-case expected diameter matching a proved lower bound as an explicit function of n,d,eps,alpha.

writing_exemplar.why: It frames optimal-value inference directly around the nondifferentiable maximum and contrasts available regularization routes.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: optimal value measures attainable personalization benefit -> its maximum is nondifferentiable at treatment ties -> ordinary semiparametric intervals are not directly applicable -> build honest uncertainty quantification for a growing discrete-cell model

method_exemplars.technique: Sequentially learn the rule and nuisances, evaluate one-step scores on later observations, and prove coverage with a martingale CLT while permitting rule fluctuation on tie strata.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It is the closest causal coverage proof that permits nonunique optimal treatment, though d-dependent approximation bias requires a different calibration layer.

method_exemplars.technique: Lower-bound honest expected length with an ordered modulus and construct intervals calibrated to explicit between-class bias geometry.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The destination needs a coverage-and-length benchmark rather than merely a pointwise limit law.

method_exemplars.technique: Use higher-order U-statistic corrections, Hoeffding decompositions, direct variance estimation, and studentization for nonlinear causal functionals.
method_exemplars.why_closest: A factorial-moment correction is likewise a higher-order statistic whose variance and bias are not exhausted by first-order influence theory.

open_problems.open_problem: For K>=3 treatments and d unrestricted discrete confounder cells, characterize the finite-sample minimax MSE of sum_x p_x max_{a<=K} mu_ax under fixed armwise overlap, including arbitrary multiway ties.

open_problems.why_unsolved: The binary Lambda-plus-Gamma reduction has one absolute-value diagonal, but K actions create a polyhedral fan of pairwise and higher-order tie faces. The web literature studies multi-arm rule construction or fixed-model softmax inference, while the parent explicitly excludes growing treatment count and supplies no K-dependent rate. The first binary proof step that changes is the pilot-local approximation lemma: one bivariate diagonal polynomial must become a coefficient-controlled approximation to a K-way homogeneous maximum in 2K observed-cell coordinates, uniform at intersections of tie faces. The lower proof must likewise replace paired signs by a K-ary packing or moment mixture that preserves every arm's overlap constraint; no located target-method paper provides that combination.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A matched risk formula R(n,d,K,eps), an explicit K-action tie-fan-localized polynomial/factorial estimator, and an overlap-preserving multiway lower bound valid for fixed and growing K and at arbitrary ties.

writing_exemplar.why: It provides the destination-area motivation and explains why genuinely multi-arm treatment choice cannot be reduced to independent binary comparisons.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: clinical decisions often involve more than two treatments -> most individualized-rule methods are binary -> pairwise aggregation can be incoherent -> quantify the information needed for unrestricted multi-arm optimal-value estimation across many strata

method_exemplars.technique: Construct local multivariate approximants around a nonsmooth equality set, lift monomials with factorial moments, and prove a matching moment-mixture converse.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It is the binary tie-face prototype; the destination replaces one equality diagonal by a full K-action tie fan.

method_exemplars.technique: Approximate a categorical-action maximum by softmax and control smoothing bias, influence behavior, and nuisance remainders.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It has the identical K-way maximum target and supplies the regular fixed-dimensional comparator the minimax result should recover.

method_exemplars.technique: Use approximation-moment duality to align a polynomial upper construction with indistinguishable moment-matched alternatives.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The K-dependent upper and lower bounds must expose the same dimensional dependence of a nonsmooth support function.

open_problems.why_unsolved: Existing semi-supervised optimal-treatment papers establish model-based or semiparametric improvements, while Zeng et al.'s structure-free discrete analysis treats linear effects and principally the known-p endpoint. Searches for the target-method pair found no exact interpolation for the nonsmooth unrestricted value. The first proof step that changes is pilot localization: labeled arm counts determine treatment-specific means, whereas the N-sample covariate histogram estimates p_x separately. The estimator and converse must quantify when better mass information reduces the homogeneous polynomial bias rather than only the linear baseline variance, including cells unseen in one sample but not the other.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A matched minimax formula R(n,N,d,eps), with an explicit estimator and lower bound that reduce to the supervised frontier at N=0 and the known-covariate-law frontier as N tends to infinity.

writing_exemplar.why: It frames abundant unlabeled clinical covariates as information that should improve individualized-treatment estimation and uncertainty quantification.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: outcomes and treatments are expensive to label -> covariates are often available for a much larger population -> unlabeled observations can improve treatment-value estimation -> determine their exact gain for unrestricted high-dimensional categorical optimal value

method_exemplars.technique: Compare unknown and known covariate-distribution experiments, exploit external cell-mass information, and derive finite-sample causal minimax bounds under overlap.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It uses the identical discrete causal observation model and already shows that p_x information changes rates for linear targets.

method_exemplars.technique: Use pilot-dependent polynomial degree and unbiased factorial moments for rare and unseen symbols.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The auxiliary X sample changes knowledge of rare-cell mass but not arm-specific outcome intensity, producing two effective sample sizes in one additive functional.

method_exemplars.technique: Augment supervised optimal-treatment estimating equations with covariate-only observations and prove an efficiency comparison.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It supplies the semi-supervised causal estimator architecture whose unrestricted discrete minimax behavior remains unknown.

open_problems.open_problem: Determine the exact local asymptotic minimax constant, or an equivalent finite-dimensional dual characterization, for optimal-value estimation on the observational four-cell overlap cone.

source_refs.excerpt: The exact leading constant is an open-ended question.
This handle specifies the route to the local asymptotic minimax constant without fixing its value.

open_problems.why_unsolved: The parent supplies two rate-level converse mechanisms, an equal-propensity L1 slice and a paired-sign causal mixture, but neither identifies the least-favorable local experiment for the full observational cone. The unresolved step is equality between a cone-constrained approximation primal and an overlap-preserving moment dual after rescaling each local cone by its Poisson noise geometry. It must also reconcile the small-alphabet paired-sign and dense L1 regimes and prove that the common dual value is attained by an estimator, rather than merely providing another rate comparison.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A proved normalized-risk limit with its eps-dependent constant, or an explicit primal-dual variational program whose common value is shown to be both attainable and least favorable in each asymptotic d-versus-n regime.

writing_exemplar.why: Its formulation turns a nonsmooth large-alphabet functional into an approximation-theoretic minimax problem with distinct sampling regimes.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: nonsmooth aggregate functionals defeat plug-in efficiency -> local polynomial approximation determines effective information -> moment duality identifies least-favorable distributions -> compute the sharp constant for the causal ratio cone

method_exemplars.technique: Use best-polynomial approximation and moment-problem duality so estimator bias and fuzzy-hypothesis separation share one extremal value.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The requested constant is the value of such an approximation-versus-moment dual pair, with additional overlap-cone restrictions.

method_exemplars.technique: Relate optimal estimation of an absolute-value functional to polynomial approximation and calibrated composite testing alternatives.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The local Gamma functional has the same cusp, while homogeneity and causal ratios change the local experiment.

literature_map:
1. Zeng, Balakrishnan, Han, and Kennedy (2024; arXiv:2405.00118, revised 2026) is the closest observation-model anchor: unrestricted high-dimensional discrete confounding, arbitrary cell masses, overlap, and logarithmically separated minimax bounds for linear causal effects.
2. Luedtke and van der Laan (2016, Annals of Statistics, 10.1214/15-AOS1384) identify zero blips as exceptional laws, characterize optimal-value pathwise differentiability, and give online one-step inference.
3. Whitehouse, Chen, Austern, and Syrgkanis (2025; arXiv:2507.11780, revised 2026) study the maximum-of-scores optimal value via softmax smoothing, but not a growing-alphabet minimax experiment.
4. Chen, Austern, and Syrgkanis (2023, arXiv:2303.04416) extend softmax inference to a two-period dynamic policy and expose triangular-array bias/influence bookkeeping.
5. Qian and Murphy (2011, Annals of Statistics, 10.1214/10-AOS864) give value-regret guarantees for sparse individualized rules under margin conditions, contrasting with unrestricted exact ties.
6. Athey and Wager (2021, Econometrica, 10.3982/ECTA15732) develop efficient policy learning for restricted policy classes; their target is learned-policy regret rather than direct estimation of unrestricted oracle value.
7. Jiao, Venkat, Han, and Weissman (2015, IEEE TIT, 10.1109/TIT.2015.2412945) supply the rare-symbol polynomial/factorial estimator template and n log n effective-sample enlargement.
8. Wu and Yang (2016, IEEE TIT, 10.1109/TIT.2016.2548468) supply approximation duality and moment-matching lower bounds yielding a k/[n log k] threshold for entropy.
9. Jiao, Han, and Weissman (2018, IEEE TIT, 10.1109/TIT.2018.2846245) are the closest nonsmooth analogue: two-sample L1 distance, local multivariate approximation, and a matched mixture converse.
10. Cai and Low (2011, Annals of Statistics, 10.1214/10-AOS849) show how approximation of absolute value drives both estimation and composite-hypothesis lower bounds.
11. Collier, Comminges, and Tsybakov (2020, Bernoulli, 10.3150/19-BEJ1180) derive sparse-versus-dense phase transitions for nonsmooth norm functionals, without random causal cell counts.
12. Xu, Wood, Sweeting, Roberts, and Tom (2020, Statistical Methods in Medical Research, 10.1177/0962280220920669) motivate genuinely multi-arm individualized rules and show pairwise reductions can be incoherent.
13. Zhu, Zeng, and Song (2019, JASA, 10.1080/01621459.2018.1506341) give high-dimensional Q-learning inference under sparse parametric models, distinct from structure-free categorical occupancy.
14. Gunn, Lu, and Song (2024, 10.1007/978-3-031-50690-1_9) and Sonabend-W et al. (2023, JMLR, arXiv:2012.04809) show unlabeled covariates can improve optimal-treatment estimation but do not give the unrestricted d-cell minimax interpolation.
15. The live unoccupied intersection is fixed-model causal nonregularity plus large-alphabet nonsmooth-functional minimax theory: no located paper supplies the four-cell overlap-cone Jackson/factorial estimator and matching all-regime converse.
